channel.title: Azure on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Azure on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard
item.description:
Azure ExpressRoute resiliency guard is in public preview for ExpressRoute virtual network gateways. A new resiliency model property lets you declare whether a gateway is for single-homed or multi-homed configurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SharePoint Connector for Azure Databricks
item.description:
The SharePoint connector for Azure Databricks is now generally available. It can be used through Lakeflow Connect to ingest files from SharePoint into Azure Databricks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Nested confidential (cc_v5) VMs will be retired on September 1, 2026
item.description:
Azure will retire the cc_v5 confidential VM series on September 1, 2026. After that date, the affected VM sizes will no longer be available for use or purchase, and any impacted VM not resized beforehand will be deallocated.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Perimeter link feature in network security perimeter
item.description:
Microsoft Azure added a public preview of Perimeter link (cross-perimeter connectivity) for network security perimeter. It lets trusted resources in different perimeters communicate securely using Managed Identity (MSI) without adding extra network access rules.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Private Link support over IPv6
item.description:
Azure Private Link now supports IPv6 in public preview. IPv6 private endpoints can be used from IPv6 clients in an Azure virtual network to privately access Azure PaaS services such as Azure Storage and Azure SQL Database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network routing appliance
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network routing appliance is now generally available. It provides private connectivity across virtual networks using specialized hardware designed for low latency, high throughput, and improved performance versus virtual machines.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Trusted Launch as Default
item.description:
Trusted Launch as Default is now generally available for new Azure Gen2 virtual machines and virtual machine scale sets. It automatically enables Secure Boot and vTPM for supported deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Reservation exchanges for Azure services supported by savings plans will no longer be available starting February 1, 2027
item.description:
Azure will stop allowing reservation exchanges for services covered by savings plans starting February 1, 2027. At announcement time, this applies to Azure Virtual Machine compute reservations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — July update
item.description:
GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio’s July 2026 update adds a new agent built on the Copilot SDK, plus built-in expertise from the .NET and Azure teams. It also adds more options to tailor Copilot to individual workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Enclave
item.description:
Azure Enclave is now in public preview for Microsoft Azure, Azure Government, Azure Government Secret, and Azure Government Top Secret. It is intended to simplify deployment and management of isolated cloud environments for sensitive workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: NAT64 on StandardV2 NAT Gateway
item.description:
StandardV2 NAT Gateway now supports NAT64. This lets IPv6 workloads reach IPv4-only internet destinations by translating synthesized outbound IPv6 traffic to IPv4, using a DNS64-capable resolver.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Prepared Image Specification
item.description:
Azure announces a public preview of Prepared Image Specification for AKS workloads that need faster node startup. The feature is aimed at reducing delays caused by repeated container image downloads and initialization on new nodes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Gateway in Azure API Management
item.description:
Azure API Management now has an AI Gateway tier in public preview. It is a dedicated tier designed for AI workloads, extending AI gateway capabilities already available in other API Management tiers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection custom policy
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection custom policy is in public preview. It lets customers set per-resource DDoS mitigation thresholds for protected Standard Load Balancer frontend IP configurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Standard service endpoint is in public preview. It provides a more scalable and secure way to connect IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services within the Private Link family, addressing scale and management limits of earlier approaches.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Public Preview: Azure Functions Support for PowerShell 7.6
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports PowerShell 7.6 in public preview. You can develop locally with PowerShell 7.6 and deploy to Azure Functions plans.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Episodic procedural memory in Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Microsoft Agent Framework now has episodic procedural memory in public preview. It stores successful task patterns so agents can reuse past action sequences, tool choices, and related context on similar future requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced platform metrics in Azure Monitor
item.description:
Azure Monitor now has advanced platform metrics in Public Preview starting July 15, 2026. The preview adds improved visibility into platform performance, resource health, and operational trends for supported Azure services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Databricks SQL Serverless in UK West
item.description:
Azure Databricks SQL Serverless is now generally available in the UK West region starting July 13, 2026. Eligible UK West workspaces can use it for analytics workloads with instant compute, automated scaling, and less infrastructure management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Exceptions in WAF for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door
item.description:
Azure Web Application Firewall now has an exceptions feature in public preview for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door. It lets you allow specific requests that would otherwise be blocked as false positives, complementing existing exclusions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Export historical data from Log Analytics workspace with Export jobs
item.description:
Azure Log Analytics now has a public preview Export job feature for exporting historical workspace data to an Azure Storage account. Exports are driven by a query and time range so you can retrieve only the needed data for external use.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: New Powershell module: Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer
item.description:
Azure announced the generally available Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer PowerShell module, a renamed module for managing Azure Database for PostgreSQL with PowerShell. It replaces the previous Az.PostgreSql-related module naming with a more streamlined experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Instant Access via application consistent restore points
item.description:
Azure added Instant Access for VM Restore Points in public preview. It lets you restore disks immediately after a restore point is created, without waiting for background replication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Migrate from Azure Blueprints by January 31, 2027
item.description:
Azure Blueprints retirement has been extended from July 11, 2026 to January 31, 2027. Phased retirement starts July 31, 2026, when creating new blueprint definitions will no longer be supported.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Application Gateway for Containers – Inference gateway
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers is adding a preview inference gateway capability. It brings the Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension to support AI inference traffic handling for Kubernetes workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Azure NetApp Files migration assistant
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files migration assistant is in preview and available generally, using SnapMirror for data migration to ANF. It supports migrations from on-premises systems and from CVO or other cloud providers.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: Beyond the benchmark: Advancing security at AI speed
item.description:
Microsoft Security says it has advanced its agentic vulnerability detection system, MDASH, and integrated it into workflows across Windows, Azure, and identity systems. The post focuses on applying the system in real-world security operations rather than benchmark results.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: ICMP Support for Azure Standard V2 NAT Gateway
item.description:
Azure StandardV2 NAT Gateway now supports outbound ICMP Echo Request and Echo Reply traffic. This lets customers use tools like ping to validate outbound connectivity and troubleshoot network issues from workloads behind the gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Log Analytics Summary Rules experience
item.description:
A new Azure portal experience for Summary Rules in Log Analytics is now generally available. Summary Rules aggregate high-volume log data on a defined schedule and store it in summarized tables for faster querying and reporting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: D-series, Ds-series, Dv2-series, Dsv2-series, and Ls-series Virtual Machines for Azure Batch pools
item.description:
Azure Compute will retire D-series, Ds-series, Dv2-series, Dsv2-series, and Ls-series VMs for Azure Batch pools on May 1, 2028. After that date, new Batch pools cannot be created with these VM series.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL MCP Server
item.description:
SQL MCP Server is now generally available. It provides a secure, high-performance way to build agentic solutions with controlled access to production data, and supports SQL with compatibility for PostgreSQL and Azure Cosmos DB.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure VPN Client for Linux (Preview) will be retired on August 31, 2026
item.description:
Azure VPN Client for Linux (Preview) will be retired on August 31, 2026 because it has remained in preview and has no path to general availability. The notice says the retirement is part of aligning Azure networking services with current security and reliability standards.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent mode for GitHub Copilot in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Agent mode is now in public preview in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). It can help investigate performance issues, tune queries, review maintenance and configuration, identify security concerns, troubleshoot errors, and assist with operational tasks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: PostgreSQL Hub for Azure Developers
item.description:
PostgreSQL Hub for Azure Developers is now generally available. It provides a centralized set of AI and application development resources for PostgreSQL on Azure, including sample apps, solution accelerators, tutorials, and learning paths.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure NC RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition v6 Series Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure NCv6-series virtual machines are now generally available in Southeast Asia and West US 2. They use NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs with 96 GB of memory per GPU.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Premium SSD v2 disks now support non-zonal Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure Premium SSD v2 disks are now generally available for non-zonal, single-instance Azure virtual machines in select regions that have Availability Zones. This lets customers deploy Premium SSD v2 without choosing an Availability Zone.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Ingestion Volume Change dashboard in Metrics Usage Insights
item.description:
Metrics Usage Insights now has an Ingestion Volume Change dashboard in public preview. It lets you compare ingestion volume over time to spot spikes or drops in time series counts and event ingestion rates.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Guest RDMA on Azure Boost
item.description:
Guest RDMA is in private preview on Azure in UK South. It uses Azure Boost to enable RDMA in the guest OS for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency networking within the same region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Discovery
item.description:
Microsoft Discovery is now generally available. It provides an enterprise platform for building and governing agentic AI workflows for research and development across scientific and engineering disciplines.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Foundry IQ
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry IQ is now generally available. It provides a managed knowledge layer for grounding agents in enterprise data, with connectors to sources such as SharePoint, OneLake, and Azure Blob.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Self-serve custom photo avatar creation in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry has generally available self-serve custom photo avatar creation in the Foundry NextGen fine-tuning portal. It is aimed at enterprise customers building voice agents or avatar-and-speech content who need a branded avatar.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Domain filter for specialized model discovery in Foundry model catalog
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry model catalog now includes a domain filter in public preview. It helps users narrow the catalog of more than 1,900 models by industry or use case.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Evaluations with Intelligent Trace Sampling
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry observability now supports intelligent trace filtering and sampling for evaluations in public preview. It evaluates a representative subset of production traces instead of all traces.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Foundry for Visual Studio Code (June Build 2026 refresh)
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry for Visual Studio Code is now generally available with a Build 2026 refresh. The update adds the full model catalog, model playground, and Hosted agent deployment directly in the editor.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Announcing: Confidential Live Migration for Intel TDX confidential VMs in Azure
item.description:
Microsoft is introducing Confidential Live Migration in Azure for Intel TDX Confidential VMs. The feature is intended to support platform servicing by moving confidential VMs while preserving availability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager
item.description:
Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager is in public preview. It provides a unified, goal-driven way to design, assess, and improve application resiliency across Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: File share centric management model (Microsoft.FileShares) for Azure Files
item.description:
The file share-centric management model for Azure Files is now generally available for NFS 4.1 shares on SSD storage. It uses the Microsoft.FileShares resource provider and makes file shares top-level Azure resources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Preview: Azure Cobalt 200 Arm-based Dpsv7, Dplsv7, Epsv7, Mpsv4, and Lpsv5-series Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure has previewed new Arm-based Cobalt 200 VM families: Dpsv7, Dplsv7, Epsv7, Mpsv4, and Lpsv5. They are positioned as improvements over the previous Cobalt 100 generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure API Management introduces a Unified Model API for multi-model AI applications.
item.description:
Azure API Management is adding a Unified Model API in public preview for multi-model AI applications. It aims to reduce integration complexity across LLM providers by standardizing API format, SDK use, and governance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Global PTU Reservations Are Now Region-Agnostic
item.description:
Global Provisioned Throughput (PTU) reservations are now region-agnostic, so one reservation can cover Global PTU deployments across multiple regions. This change is intended to improve reservation utilization and savings.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: multiparty analytics with Azure Confidential Clean Rooms
item.description:
Microsoft is previewing multiparty analytics in Azure Confidential Clean Rooms, a fully managed service for securely analyzing privacy-sensitive datasets with partners using Apache Spark-based big data tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Storage optimized Lasv5 and Laosv5 Azure VM series
item.description:
Lasv5 and Laosv5 storage-optimized Azure VM series are now in private preview. They use 5th Gen AMD EPYC (Turin) processors and target storage-intensive workloads, with Lasv5 focused on high disk capacity, throughput, and I/O.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Automatic OS Image Upgrades for VMSS Flex
item.description:
Automatic OS image upgrades are now in public preview for Virtual Machine Scale Sets (VMSS) using Flexible Orchestration. The feature extends automated fleet-wide image upgrades to VMSS Flex to reduce manual update work.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Dynamic threshold for Log search alerts
item.description:
General availability of Dynamic threshold for Log search alerts. Dynamic thresholds automatically calculate appropriate alert thresholds, reducing the need to set a fixed threshold manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Anyscale on Azure
item.description:
Anyscale on Azure is now in public preview. It provides a managed Ray platform for running Python workloads at scale on Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Container Apps Sandboxes
item.description:
Azure Container Apps Sandboxes is in public preview. It is positioned for workloads that need to run untrusted code, retain session state, and absorb bursty demand.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions now includes managed connectors to integrate with 1400+ of your favorite systems
item.description:
Azure Functions Public Preview now supports managed connectors as first-class triggers and operations. This brings access to the same 1,400+ connector ecosystem used by Logic Apps and Power Platform for integrating with external systems.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is in public preview as a PostgreSQL-compatible database service. The preview highlights autoscaling storage up to 128 TB and claimed performance improvements over self-managed PostgreSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Benchmark evaluations for fine-tuned models in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now offers public preview benchmark evaluations for fine-tuned models. The feature is aimed at comparing model performance on tasks such as reasoning, math, and domain knowledge, where leaderboard results may not reflect real-world behavior.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public preview: Connector Namespace
item.description:
Azure has introduced Connector Namespace in public preview. It is a managed service intended to simplify app integration with SaaS and line-of-business systems by providing pre-built connectors instead of custom API client code.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Foundry Memory preview refresh
item.description:
Microsoft refreshed the Foundry Memory public preview with a redesigned storage model, new retrieval controls, and tighter integration with the Foundry Agent Service tool surface. Agents can now use Memory to write, search, and update user-scoped data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Image serving in Foundry IQ knowledge bases
item.description:
Foundry IQ knowledge bases in public preview can now return document-extracted images at query time. During ingestion, images such as figures, screenshots, and diagrams are extracted from PDFs, slides, and Office files and stored alongside the source text.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Knowledge as a Service with Azure Logic Apps.
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps is introducing a public preview aimed at simplifying RAG by providing “Knowledge as a Service.” The update says teams can avoid building and operating the full ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector store, and retrieval stack themselves.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Defender security assessments for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Microsoft Defender security assessments are now in public preview for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The feature continuously evaluates database security posture to help identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: OmniVec, an open-source embedding toolkit for Azure
item.description:
Microsoft announced a public preview of OmniVec, an open-source embedding toolkit for Azure. It automates embedding generation from multiple data sources and writes results to Azure Cosmos DB and other Azure destinations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Center now supports agent registration, agent assessment, and Git-based synchronization.
item.description:
Azure API Center now generally supports agent registration, agent assessment, and Git-based synchronization. The update is positioned as a way to help teams discover, govern, and reuse autonomous AI agents across an organization.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Management adds support for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) APIs
item.description:
Azure API Management now supports Agent-to-Agent (A2A) APIs in general availability. The update is intended to bring agent traffic under existing API governance and management controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure API Management workspaces now support the built-in gateway
item.description:
Azure API Management workspaces now support the built-in gateway in general availability. This removes the prior requirement for a dedicated workspace gateway and Premium tier deployment, reducing cost and operational complexity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for MySQL now available in new regions and expanded availability zones
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server is now generally available in new regions and with expanded availability zone support. The update adds deployment options in Denmark East and Austria East, with the content truncated before listing the full set of regions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure DocumentDB instant free tier clusters
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now supports generally available instant free tier cluster provisioning on Azure. The update says free tier clusters can be created with near-instant provisioning so users can start immediately.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure DocumentDB Migration Extension in Visual Studio Code
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB Migration Extension for Visual Studio Code is now generally available. It lets you create, run, and manage migration jobs from VS Code to move data from on-premises or cloud-based MongoDB sources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions now supports hosting MCP Apps
item.description:
Azure Functions now generally supports hosting MCP apps. The update notes that MCP servers can use richer interactions beyond plain text, including visual data exploration, complex configuration, real-time status monitoring, and multi-step workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Data API builder with built-in GitHub Copilot in MSSQL extension
item.description:
The MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code now generally available includes Data API builder with built-in GitHub Copilot integration. It supports guided generation of REST, GraphQL, and Model Context Protocol back ends in the development workflow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Public Preview: Azure API Management now supports token metrics for all token types
item.description:
Azure API Management Public Preview adds token metrics for all token types. It extends tracking beyond prompt and completion tokens to include newer categories such as cached, reasoning, and thinking tokens.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Public Preview: Hosted Agents in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service now has a public preview for Hosted Agents, a container-based runtime for deploying custom agent code on Microsoft-managed infrastructure. Each Hosted Agent runs in a per-session VM-isolated environment.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions Support for Node.js 24
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports Node.js 24 in general availability. Apps can be developed locally with Node.js 24 and deployed to supported Azure Functions plans on Linux and Windows, including Flex Consumption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Application Gateway for Containers – Service Mesh integration with Istio
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers service mesh integration with Istio is now generally available. It automates mTLS connectivity for secure north-south traffic into workloads running in an Istio service mesh.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Virtual network flow logs connector with Microsoft Sentinel
item.description:
Azure virtual network flow logs connector with Microsoft Sentinel is now generally available. It lets you export and analyze network traffic data in Microsoft Sentinel security workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 in Azure App Service, Azure Functions, and Azure Logic Apps
item.description:
Azure App Service, Azure Functions, and Azure Logic Apps will stop accepting TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 connections after May 31, 2027. Clients and services must use TLS 1.2 or later to continue connecting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: User Groups and IP address pools for P2S connections
item.description:
Azure VPN Gateway Point-to-Site connections now support User Groups and IP address pools, letting administrators assign different client IP ranges to remote users based on their credentials.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Server on Azure VMs in Malaysia West, Indonesia Central
item.description:
SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines is now generally available in the Malaysia West and Indonesia Central Azure regions. This expands deployment options for SQL Server workloads closer to users and supports data residency needs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Summarized advertised gateway prefixes for route advertisement
item.description:
Azure public preview now lets you configure summarized advertised gateway prefixes for route advertisement. Azure gateways, including ExpressRoute and VPN Gateway, can advertise summarized prefixes to on-premises networks instead of all individual prefixes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: site-to-site VPN connections with certificate authentication
item.description:
Azure Site-to-Site VPN now supports certificate-based authentication as an alternative to pre-shared keys. This uses an asymmetric trust model for Azure and on-premises VPN device authentication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Network Watcher rule impact analyser
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher rule impact analyzer is now generally available. It lets you assess the potential effect of NSG or security admin rule changes on live network traffic before applying them.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Blob Storage SDK for Rust
item.description:
Azure Blob Storage SDK for Rust is now generally available. It supports connecting to Azure Blob Storage accounts and performing container/blob operations such as upload, download, list, and management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Container Apps Express
item.description:
Azure Container Apps Express is now in public preview. It is presented as a simplified way to deploy and scale applications on Azure without making infrastructure decisions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Update: 99.99% uptime for all Azure Service Bus Premium namespaces in Availability Zone regions
item.description:
Starting May 1, 2026, Azure Service Bus Premium namespaces deployed in regions with Availability Zone support will qualify for a 99.99% uptime SLA. This applies to all Premium namespaces in those regions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network Manager rule impact analyzer
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network Manager rule impact analyzer is now generally available. It lets you simulate the effect of security admin rules on virtual networks before deploying them.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Sentinel TI - improved pattern parsing & revoke reliability
item.description:
Sentinel TI is now generally available with two updates: improved pattern parsing accuracy and a fix for revoke actions so they apply reliably. The change is meant to improve control in pattern-based workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates
